caption: The drawing depicts a single porcelain bowl positioned centrally within a rectangular boundary on a plain, light beige background. The bowl is round with a slightly outward curving rim and a narrower base. Its outer surface is predominantly white, featuring a thin yellow line along the rim and another around the base. There is a delicate blue illustration on the side of the bowl, depicting a subtle landscape or possibly figures, rendered with fine, sketch-like lines. The entire composition is minimal, and the drawing emphasizes the details and decoration of the bowl against an otherwise unembellished background.
title: Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
